title: About the website
content:
# Hi!  I'm mouning

This is a personal website dedicated to me.

-This space serves as a record of my studies, programming endeavors, interests, and some thoughts from my daily life.
 
-In addition, this place will also hold my favorite anime, music, games, and some things worth recording.

-I hope that in a few years, when I come back to visit here, I will be able to clearly see:

>What I have learned, what I have done, and how I have gradually come to where I am today.

— Mouning
